typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Date as date,
		Location as string,
		{Usable Capacity KW} as float,
		{Consumed Reading KW} as float,
		{AVG Consumption Percent} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Fname = $FileName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		FileName as string,
		AVGConsumptionPercent as string,
		UsableCapacityKW as float,
		ConsumedReadingKW as float,
		Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Location as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FileName = Fname,
		AVGConsumptionPercent = {AVG Consumption Percent},
		UsableCapacityKW = {Usable Capacity KW},
		ConsumedReadingKW = {Consumed Reading KW},
		Date,
		Location),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
